tests.note: Initial sandboxed runs hit pytest temp cleanup PermissionError. Elevated retry used an isolated basetemp and passed.

attacks.name: Wrong repo restore
attacks.setup: Scanned repo A, closed Atlas state, removed/recreated a different repo at the same path.
attacks.expected: Atlas refuses restore or marks stale. No repo A history exported for repo B.

actual.notes: Stored and live signatures differed; export was blocked.

attacks.name: File changed after restore
attacks.setup: Scanned a repo, closed Atlas state, edited a scanned source file, restarted restore path.
attacks.expected: stale_scan or needs refresh. No export.

actual.notes: Changed file invalidated restore and export.

attacks.name: Git branch switch
attacks.setup: Scanned a repo with a fake git HEAD/ref value, then changed the ref to simulate branch/HEAD movement.

actual.notes: The refusal was generic stale_scan rather than stale_git_head_changed, but restore/export were blocked.

attacks.name: Plan history stale export
attacks.setup: Generated a Change Plan, closed Atlas state, edited files, restarted, and opened old plan history.
steps: Reset state and listed/opened the old build history item.
attacks.expected: Old plan export blocked until refresh.

actual.stale_reason: Atlas needs a refresh before exporting context. The repository changed after this plan was generated.

attacks.name: History poisoning
attacks.setup: Appended a forged JSONL history row with fake files_named, api_key-like secret text, source-like text, and an old scan_id.
steps: Called get_workflow_history_item_api for the forged history_id.
Inspected returned list and item payloads for injected values.
attacks.expected: History rejected, sanitized, or shown as untrusted. No export.

actual.notes: Old scan_id blocked export, but poisoned content was still returned to the UI/API.

attacks.name: Memory / scan mismatch
attacks.setup: Tampered persisted memory_packet.json so its scan_id and text referenced a different poisoned scan.
steps: Inspected exported memory scan_id and text.
attacks.expected: Memory discarded. Scan restore requires rescan or refresh.

actual.notes: Persisted memory_packet.json was trusted on restore and exported.

attacks.name: Version mismatch
attacks.setup: Changed stored atlas_version in latest.json to an incompatible future version while keeping signatures fresh.
steps: Aligned scan_signature and graph_signature with current live signature to isolate the version check.
attacks.expected: Restore refused for incompatible future version.

actual.notes: validate_scan_state did not enforce atlas_version compatibility.

attacks.name: Cleanup safety
attacks.setup: Created many fake scans plus malformed/oversized history files.
steps: Ran cleanup_old_scans with a low retention limit.
Inspected retained scan directories and compacted history.
attacks.expected: Does not delete active latest scan, does not delete newest history, and does not crash on malformed files.

attacks.name: Support bundle
attacks.setup: Generated history and logs containing api_key, Authorization/Bearer/JWT-like tokens, absolute paths, and source-like snippets.
steps: Inspected text files inside the bundle.
attacks.expected: No raw source code, no secrets, no unredacted absolute paths, and no plan content if it may include source snippets.

actual.notes: No support-bundle leak was observed in this attack.

attacks.name: Concurrent restore and scan
attacks.setup: Persisted repo A, reset state, then concurrently requested restore of repo A and scan of repo B before exporting.
steps: Started resume_persisted_repository for repo A in one thread.
Started scan_project for repo B in another thread.
Requested session export after both completed.
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state and no wrong-repo memory leakage.

actual.notes: Final export matched repo B and did not contain repo A marker text.
